hackathons.title: 2027 WFEO Hackathon on Sustainable Transport Engineering
hackathons.eligibility: Teams of 3 to 5 participants led by an engineering student or young engineer under 30
hackathons.summary: The 2027 WFEO Hackathon invites participants to solve global sustainable transport engineering challenges. Teams collaborate during a three-week online period to build and submit innovative solutions.
